subject.title: feat(claude): add claude-bridge app-server harness extension

question: Should OpenClaw adopt and permanently own the Claude app-server harness and its executable bridge package, or require this capability to ship as an external plugin?
rationale: The owner choice determines package provenance, vulnerability response, auth and state ownership, allowable SDK/core changes, release publication, and the appropriate repair shape; automation cannot safely choose those product and security commitments.

options.title: External plugin
options.body: Keep the harness and bridge contributor-owned and publish through npm and ClawHub, requesting only narrowly generic SDK seams from OpenClaw.

options.title: OpenClaw adoption
options.body: Move bridge source and publishing under OpenClaw ownership, then redesign storage, auth, dependency policy, and release handling before merge.

options.title: Use existing paths
options.body: Decline the extra harness and focus work on the Anthropic provider, Claude CLI, and ACP reliability gaps instead.

recommendation.title: External plugin
recommendation.body: Keep the harness and bridge contributor-owned and publish through npm and ClawHub, requesting only narrowly generic SDK seams from OpenClaw.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main Codex harness ownership makes steipete the best available product-routing owner for whether a parallel bundled Claude harness should exist.
